body:
(Replaces my note of 10:47 UTC: its trigger for the phone push was wrong, see piece 3.)

HANDLES (scanner.py, api.py, live.py, navidrome.py, refs.py read 6 Nov 2026, main 068c71a; B-60 has the measured 47 + 23 minutes).

WHAT EXISTS: `LibraryLinker` (scanner.py:144-209) wakes at once on `poke()` (`_soon.wait`, ~line 196); it only lacks a caller. It is built in create_app (api.py:1423) with `every_s = ENCORE_SCAN_EVERY_MIN * 60` and kept in `Services.linker` (api.py:92). The music server client has `start_scan()` and `scan_status()` -> `{scanning, lastScan, count}` (navidrome.py:128-139).

THREE SMALL PIECES
 1. Link when the music server finishes: a watcher in the linker's thread asks `scan_status()` every 30 s (one tiny call) and pokes when `scanning` has gone false and `lastScan` changed. Never run a pass during a scan: do P3-33 first, same file.
 2. A Host-only door: `POST /encore/api/v1/library/scan` calls `start_scan()` then `poke()` and answers in plain words ("Looking for new music"; later "3 new albums"). Not in docs/17 yet: add it to the planned column in the same PR. Two doors (D-61): the admin page button (P3-06) and a command. `encore_server.__main__` knows only `setup` and `backup` and any other word starts the server (B-57, P3-14): fix that parsing before adding `scan` there.
 3. Tell the phones, but not every hour. `report.linked` counts EVERY song of every pass (`attach_file` is idempotent, scanner.py:100-110), about 7,200 on each tick, so "linked > 0" would send everybody a push hourly. The exact signal already exists: `attach_file` writes nothing to the global `file_log` feed when the file is already attached (refs.py:239-240), so compare `MAX(seq)` of `file_log` before and after the pass (`new_refs` counts new songs, not new files). Add `new_files` to `LinkReport` from that. When it is above 0, publish the existing `resync` event (the app treats `hello`, `library.changed` and `resync` alike, app/lib/app/session.dart:540). The hub publishes per person only (live.py ~70-90): add a broadcast to everyone connected, rate-limited like `keep.progress`. `LibraryLinker` has no `on_changed` hook today (the keeper does, `tell`, api.py:1348): add one.

TESTS: tests/test_scanner.py `FakeLibrary` (extend with `scan_status`) and test_the_linker_runs_by_itself_soon_after_start_and_again_when_poked (175). New: a pass that finds nothing new sends no push (the hourly-tick test); a pass with one new file sends exactly one; no pass while scanning; a hub test that a connected device gets `resync`. Phones: with the app open the foreground sync is 10 minutes without a push, seconds with it.

DOCS in the same PR: docs/15 (the Library page promises "scan now"), docs/17 (the route, the event), docs/22 (a scan of 7,200 files took 4 min 36 s).
